derry_home_boatman.text: The Foyle is a tidal river. In the morning it is high and silvery, and in the evening it has gone out for a walk.
Selklet pop up near the estuary and watch you with big dark eyes. They are very polite, for seals.
I have never caught a salmon here. The salmon have never caught me. We have an understanding.

then.text: Back for the Champ? Kitchen's yours.

else.text: Spring onions, love. Lots of spring onions. And no skimping on the butter.
Steep the spring onions in warm milk first, then beat it all into the mash. The butter goes in the hole in the middle, and you dip your fork.
Pop in whenever you've got the makings. Use my kitchen.
